modelDescription: Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) recurrent neural network. Uses a 2-layer stacked LSTM with 128 hidden units processing 12-month sliding windows of price sequences. Features include normalized price, cyclical month encoding, year trend, and categorical encodings for region and price type. Trained per-commodity with AdamW optimizer, Huber loss (robust to outliers), learning rate scheduling, gradient clipping, and early stopping. Captures temporal dependencies and seasonality patterns that tree-based models may miss.
